muscles.name: Gluteus maximus
muscles.role: Main hip extensor. Stretched under load at the bottom; its activity climbs steeply with depth.

muscles.name: Gluteus medius
muscles.role: Holds the pelvis level and resists the knees caving in.

muscles.name: Gluteus minimus
muscles.role: Deep hip abductor and stabiliser of the femoral head.

muscles.name: Piriformis
muscles.role: Deep hip rotator; at deep hip flexion it helps abduct and stabilise the hip.

muscles.name: Iliacus
muscles.role: Hip flexor. Lightly loaded in a squat: most active near lockout, where the bar sits slightly behind the hips, and as a hip stabiliser.

muscles.name: Psoas major
muscles.role: Hip flexor that also stiffens the lumbar spine. Lightly loaded in a squat.

muscles.name: Tensor fasciae latae
muscles.role: Small hip flexor/abductor that tensions the IT band.

muscles.name: Iliotibial tract
muscles.role: Thick band of fascia on the outer thigh, tensioned by the TFL and gluteus maximus. Not contractile.

muscles.name: Sartorius
muscles.role: Long strap muscle; hip flexor and external rotator, minor role here.

muscles.name: Rectus femoris
muscles.role: The only quad that crosses the hip, so its length barely changes in a squat. EMG shows it working at roughly half the level of the vasti.

muscles.name: Vastus lateralis
muscles.role: Largest knee extensor and, with the other vasti, the most active leg muscle out of the hole.

muscles.name: Vastus medialis
muscles.role: Knee extensor working about as hard as vastus lateralis through full depth; helps track the patella.

muscles.name: Vastus intermedius
muscles.role: Deep quad lying directly on the femur; pure knee extensor.

muscles.name: Adductor longus
muscles.role: Adducts the femur; at deep hip flexion it also helps extend the hip.

muscles.name: Adductor brevis
muscles.role: Adducts and steadies the femur as the knees travel out.

muscles.name: Adductor magnus
muscles.role: Its rear (ischial) part is a powerful hip extensor at depth, often the sorest muscle after deep squats.

muscles.name: Adductor minimus
muscles.role: Uppermost slip of the adductor magnus; adducts and extends the hip.

muscles.name: Gracilis
muscles.role: Thin adductor crossing hip and knee; minor role.

muscles.name: Biceps femoris (long head)
muscles.role: Hamstring. Lengthens at the hip while shortening at the knee, so its length barely changes; moderate activity.

muscles.name: Biceps femoris (short head)
muscles.role: Single-joint knee flexor; low activity in the squat.

muscles.name: Semitendinosus
muscles.role: Medial hamstring; assists hip extension and stabilises the knee. Moderate activity.

muscles.name: Semimembranosus
muscles.role: Medial hamstring; assists hip extension and stabilises the knee. Moderate activity.

muscles.name: Gastrocnemius (lateral head)
muscles.role: Plantarflexor crossing knee and ankle; keeps the weight balanced over midfoot as the shins travel forward.

muscles.name: Gastrocnemius (medial head)
muscles.role: Plantarflexor crossing knee and ankle; keeps the weight balanced over midfoot as the shins travel forward.

muscles.name: Soleus
muscles.role: Controls forward shin travel (dorsiflexion) under load.

muscles.name: Achilles (calcaneal) tendon
muscles.role: Shared tendon of the calf muscles. Not contractile.

muscles.name: Plantaris
muscles.role: Small, weak plantarflexor beside the gastrocnemius; negligible contribution.

muscles.name: Tibialis anterior
muscles.role: Pulls the shin forward over the foot on the way down and supports the inner arch.

muscles.name: Tibialis posterior
muscles.role: Supports the arch and resists the foot rolling in.

muscles.name: Extensor digitorum longus
muscles.role: Toe and ankle extensor; low activity, helps steady the shin over the foot.

muscles.name: Extensor hallucis longus
muscles.role: Big-toe and ankle extensor; low activity.

muscles.name: Fibularis tertius
muscles.role: Small evertor and ankle extensor; minor role.

muscles.name: Flexor digitorum longus
muscles.role: Toe flexor; grips the floor and supports the arch.

muscles.name: Flexor hallucis longus
muscles.role: Big-toe flexor; presses the big toe down and supports the arch.

muscles.name: Fibularis longus
muscles.role: Everts the foot and presses the big-toe side down, keeping the foot planted.

muscles.name: Fibularis brevis
muscles.role: Everts and steadies the foot.

muscles.name: Obturator internus
muscles.role: Deep external rotator; holds the femoral head in the socket and resists the knees caving in.

muscles.name: Obturator externus
muscles.role: Deep external rotator; holds the femoral head in the socket and resists the knees caving in.

muscles.name: Gemellus superior
muscles.role: Small deep external rotator working with obturator internus.

muscles.name: Gemellus inferior
muscles.role: Small deep external rotator working with obturator internus.

muscles.name: Quadratus femoris
muscles.role: Deep external rotator; resists the knees caving in.

muscles.name: Pectineus
muscles.role: Hip flexor and adductor; minor role in the squat.

muscles.name: Popliteus
muscles.role: Unlocks and stabilises the knee; resists the tibia rotating outward under load.

muscles.name: Rectus abdominis
muscles.role: Bracing: helps build intra-abdominal pressure with the obliques.

muscles.name: External oblique
muscles.role: Bracing and anti-rotation.

muscles.name: Internal oblique
muscles.role: Deep bracing muscle under the external oblique.

muscles.name: Quadratus lumborum
muscles.role: Stiffens the lumbar spine side to side.

muscles.name: Iliocostalis lumborum
muscles.role: Holds the spine against the forward-bending moment of the bar; mostly isometric.

muscles.name: Iliocostalis thoracis
muscles.role: Holds the spine against the forward-bending moment of the bar; mostly isometric.

muscles.name: Longissimus thoracis
muscles.role: Holds the spine against the forward-bending moment of the bar; mostly isometric.

muscles.name: Spinalis thoracis
muscles.role: Holds the spine against the forward-bending moment of the bar; mostly isometric.

muscles.name: Multifidus
muscles.role: Deep segmental spinal extensor; controls each lumbar level.

muscles.name: Semispinalis thoracis
muscles.role: Deep spinal extensor; holds posture of the upper spine and neck.

muscles.name: Serratus posterior inferior
muscles.role: Thin muscle over the lower ribs; little role in the lift.

muscles.name: Latissimus dorsi
muscles.role: Pulled tight to lock the upper back and keep the bar from rolling.

muscles.name: Trapezius (descending part)
muscles.role: The shelf the bar rests on in a high-bar position.

muscles.name: Trapezius (transverse part)
muscles.role: Pulls the shoulder blades together to tighten the upper back.

muscles.name: Trapezius (ascending part)
muscles.role: Depresses and sets the shoulder blades.

muscles.name: Rhomboid major
muscles.role: Retracts the shoulder blade to build the upper-back shelf.

muscles.name: Rhomboid minor
muscles.role: Retracts the shoulder blade to build the upper-back shelf.

muscles.name: Levator scapulae
muscles.role: Lifts and steadies the shoulder blade; part of the soft-tissue shelf under a high bar.

muscles.name: Serratus anterior
muscles.role: Holds the shoulder blade against the rib cage.

muscles.name: Pectoralis minor
muscles.role: Tilts the shoulder blade forward; low activity.

muscles.name: Subclavius
muscles.role: Steadies the collarbone.

muscles.name: Sternocleidomastoid
muscles.role: Flexes and turns the neck; helps hold the head steady.

muscles.name: Scalenus anterior
muscles.role: Neck muscle that lifts the first rib; assists the big breath taken to brace.

muscles.name: Scalenus medius
muscles.role: Neck muscle that lifts the first rib; assists the big breath taken to brace.

muscles.name: Scalenus posterior
muscles.role: Neck muscle that lifts the second rib; assists the big breath taken to brace.

muscles.name: Splenius capitis
muscles.role: Neck extensor; stops the head dropping forward as the trunk leans.

muscles.name: Splenius cervicis
muscles.role: Neck extensor; stops the head dropping forward as the trunk leans.

muscles.name: Semispinalis capitis
muscles.role: Deep neck extensor; holds the head in line with the trunk.

muscles.name: Semispinalis cervicis
muscles.role: Deep neck extensor; holds the head in line with the trunk.

muscles.name: Longissimus capitis
muscles.role: Neck extensor; holds the head in line with the trunk.

muscles.name: Longissimus cervicis
muscles.role: Neck extensor; holds the neck in line with the trunk.

muscles.name: Iliocostalis cervicis
muscles.role: Upper end of the back extensors; holds the neck and upper ribs.

muscles.name: Spinalis cervicis
muscles.role: Neck extensor; holds the neck in line with the trunk.

muscles.name: Serratus posterior superior
muscles.role: Thin muscle over the upper ribs; little role in the lift.

muscles.name: Deltoid (acromial part)
muscles.role: Holds the arm out to the side on the bar.

muscles.name: Deltoid (clavicular part)
muscles.role: Front deltoid; low activity in a back squat.

muscles.name: Deltoid (spinal part)
muscles.role: Rear deltoid; part of the shelf and holds the arm back on the bar.

muscles.name: Pectoralis major (clavicular part)
muscles.role: Moves the arm forward and in; low activity in a back squat.

muscles.name: Pectoralis major (sternocostal part)
muscles.role: Moves the arm forward and in; low activity in a back squat.

muscles.name: Pectoralis major (abdominal part)
muscles.role: Pulls the arm down and in; low activity in a back squat.

muscles.name: Teres major
muscles.role: Pulls the arm down and back; helps the lats lock the upper back.

muscles.name: Teres minor
muscles.role: Rotator cuff; keeps the humeral head centred while the arm is held back on the bar.

muscles.name: Infraspinatus
muscles.role: Rotator cuff; holds the arm turned out on the bar and keeps the humeral head centred.

muscles.name: Supraspinatus
muscles.role: Rotator cuff; keeps the humeral head centred in its socket.

muscles.name: Subscapularis
muscles.role: Rotator cuff; keeps the humeral head centred in its socket.

muscles.name: Coracobrachialis
muscles.role: Small arm flexor and adductor; minor role.

muscles.name: Biceps brachii (long head)
muscles.role: Elbow flexor; helps hold the elbow bent on the bar.

muscles.name: Biceps brachii (short head)
muscles.role: Elbow flexor; helps hold the elbow bent on the bar.

muscles.name: Brachialis
muscles.role: Main elbow flexor; holds the elbow bent.

muscles.name: Triceps brachii (long head)
muscles.role: Elbow extensor; low activity. The long head also steadies the shoulder.

muscles.name: Triceps brachii (lateral head)
muscles.role: Elbow extensor; low activity.

muscles.name: Triceps brachii (medial head)
muscles.role: Elbow extensor; low activity.

muscles.name: Anconeus
muscles.role: Small elbow extensor and stabiliser.

muscles.name: Brachioradialis
muscles.role: Elbow flexor; helps hold the forearm position.

muscles.name: Extensor carpi radialis longus
muscles.role: Wrist extensor; holds the wrist steady while gripping.

muscles.name: Extensor carpi radialis brevis
muscles.role: Wrist extensor; holds the wrist steady while gripping.

muscles.name: Extensor digitorum
muscles.role: Finger extensor; balances the finger flexors in the grip.

muscles.name: Extensor carpi ulnaris (humeral head)
muscles.role: Wrist extensor and ulnar deviator; steadies the wrist.

muscles.name: Extensor carpi ulnaris (ulnar head)
muscles.role: Wrist extensor and ulnar deviator; steadies the wrist.

muscles.name: Flexor carpi radialis
muscles.role: Wrist flexor; works with the finger flexors to grip the bar.

muscles.name: Palmaris longus
muscles.role: Weak wrist flexor that tenses the palm; missing altogether in a sizeable minority of people.

muscles.name: Flexor carpi ulnaris (humeral head)
muscles.role: Wrist flexor; works with the finger flexors to grip the bar.

muscles.name: Flexor carpi ulnaris (ulnar head)
muscles.role: Wrist flexor; works with the finger flexors to grip the bar.

muscles.name: Flexor digitorum superficialis (humeroulnar head)
muscles.role: Finger flexor; closes the fingers around the bar.

muscles.name: Flexor digitorum superficialis (radial head)
muscles.role: Finger flexor; closes the fingers around the bar.

muscles.name: Flexor digitorum profundus
muscles.role: Deep finger flexor; curls the fingertips over the bar.

muscles.name: Flexor pollicis longus
muscles.role: Flexes the thumb tip around the bar.

muscles.name: Pronator teres (humeral head)
muscles.role: Turns the palm down and flexes the elbow; minor role.

muscles.name: Pronator teres (ulnar head)
muscles.role: Turns the palm down; minor role.

muscles.name: Supinator
muscles.role: Turns the palm up; minor role.

muscles.name: Abductor pollicis longus
muscles.role: Moves the thumb away from the palm and steadies its base.

muscles.name: Extensor pollicis longus
muscles.role: Extends the thumb; minor role in the grip.

muscles.name: Extensor indicis
muscles.role: Extends the index finger; minor role.

muscles.name: Pronator quadratus
muscles.role: Turns the palm down and binds the radius and ulna together.

muscles.name: External intercostals
muscles.role: Lift the ribs; active when the lifter takes a big breath to brace.
